Label: Physical radiation research infrastructure
definition: A material entity such as physical resources, facilities, or personnel organized to support radiation biology research.
editor note: Primary parent for physical infrastructure assets.

Label: Digital radiation research infrastructure
definition: An information content entity that consists of digital resources, data systems, and models organized to support radiation biology research.
editor note: Primary parent for digital/information infrastructure assets.

Label: radiation exposure facility
definition: A facility specifically designed to provide controlled radiation exposure to biological or physical samples for research purposes.

Label: external exposure facility
definition: A radiation exposure facility in which biological or physical samples are irradiated by a radiation source external to the subject, including photon, particle beam, neutron, radon and calibration irradiation systems.

Label: internal exposure facility
definition: A radiation exposure facility in which biological subjects are exposed to radionuclides via incorporation routes such as inhalation, ingestion or wound contamination, resulting in internal radiation exposure from incorporated radionuclides.

Label: contaminated site observatory
definition: A geographically defined area contaminated with radionuclides or naturally occurring radioactive materials (NORM) that is formally designated as a long-term field research site for radioecological investigation.
editor note: Polyhierarchy: child of both Physical Infrastructure and BFO:Site.

Label: radiation research analytical platform
definition: A facility providing specialised analytical capabilities including biodosimetry, genomics, proteomics, radiochemistry, in vivo bioassay or imaging used to characterise biological samples or measure radiation-related outcomes in support of radiation biology and radiation protection research.

Label: radiation research sample bank
definition: A physical infrastructure for the systematic storage and management of biological or environmental samples related to radiation research.

Label: radiation epidemiology cohort
definition: A research infrastructure centered around a defined group of individuals (aggregate of organisms) tracked over time for radiation-related health outcomes.

Label: radiation biology database
definition: An information content entity consisting of structured collections of data related to radiation biology research.

Label: radiation dosimetry model
definition: A computational model, simulation code or software application used to calculate radiation doses, model the biological effects of ionising radiation, assess environmental radiation risk, or support radiological emergency response decision-making.

Label: radiation dosimetry tool
definition: A physical infrastructure consisting of devices or instruments used to measure radiation dose.
